name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_destroy
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnDestroy delegates to the MFC base and cancels the session refresh timer. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The method is provider-backed for CWnd::OnDestroy and USER32 KillTimer; the smoke verifies call order and arguments through import patching.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b680 validates the sequence: CWnd::OnDestroy(this), load m_hWnd from offset 0x20, then KillTimer(hwnd, 2).
The native smoke patches MFC42 CWnd::OnDestroy ordinal 6453 and USER32 KillTimer, then verifies the call order, self pointer, HWND, and timer id 2.
